about.description:
Charliecloud uses Linux user and mount namespaces to run unprivileged
containers from standard image formats (Docker/OCI) without a daemon or
setuid root binary, letting HPC users run containerized workloads on
cluster compute nodes. It includes ch-run (a small C binary launcher),
ch-image (a Python image manager and builder), and ch-convert (an image
format converter), targeting environments where rootless Docker/Podman
aren't viable but unprivileged user namespaces are available.
about.summary: Lightweight user-defined software stacks for high-performance computing.

name: charliecloud
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.45" %}

package:
  name: charliecloud
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  # Release asset, not the raw git archive: bundles a pre-generated configure
  # and Lark, so the build needs no network access or autotools bootstrap.
  url: https://gitlab.com/charliecloud/charliecloud/-/releases/v{{ version }}/downloads/charliecloud-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7ff265669751e2593ffed832cc3d98efddd367f306390feeb7714192d54b90bd

build:
  number: 1
  skip: true  # [not linux]
  script:
    # buggy-build: bin/str.h poisons strdup/strcmp/strncmp, colliding with
    # glibc's _FORTIFY_SOURCE macros of the same names under -Werror.
    # disable-test: matches the old patch's behavior, skipping the
    # sotest/fixture tree entirely (no more DSO whitelist or symlink fixup).
    - ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --enable-buggy-build --disable-html --disable-man --disable-test --enable-ch-image
    - make -j${CPU_COUNT}
    - make install

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make
    # configure needs this to locate libfuse3 for squashfuse support.
    - pkg-config

  host:
    # python is pinned by conda-forge's build matrix; vmin_python=3.6
    # in configure.ac but the matrix only builds against 3.10+ anyway.
    - python
    - requests >=2.6.0

  run:
    - python
    - requests >=2.6.0
    - tar
    # ch-image autodetects git and enables the build-cache feature by default.
    - git
    # SquashFS image support (vmin_mksquashfs=4.2, vmin_squashfuse=0.1.100).
    - squashfs-tools >=4.2
    - squashfuse >=0.1.100

test:
  commands:
    # ch-run writes --version to stderr (argp default), so don't pipe-grep it.
    - ch-run --help
    - ch-run --version
    - ch-image --help
    - ch-image --version | grep -Fx {{ version }}
    - ch-convert --help
    # No-network dependency check; also exercises the bundled Lark import.
    - ch-image gestalt dependencies

about:
  home: https://charliecloud.io/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Lightweight user-defined software stacks for high-performance computing.
  description: |
    Charliecloud uses Linux user and mount namespaces to run unprivileged
    containers from standard image formats (Docker/OCI) without a daemon or
    setuid root binary, letting HPC users run containerized workloads on
    cluster compute nodes. It includes ch-run (a small C binary launcher),
    ch-image (a Python image manager and builder), and ch-convert (an image
    format converter), targeting environments where rootless Docker/Podman
    aren't viable but unprivileged user namespaces are available.
  dev_url: https://gitlab.com/charliecloud/charliecloud
  doc_url: https://charliecloud.io/latest/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MilkClouds
    - ngam
